requirements.title: PRESENT argument restriction
requirements.definition: A shall be the name of an optional dummy argument accessible in the subprogram containing the PRESENT reference; there are no other requirements on A.

pending.PRESENT-A-optional-dummy-accessible: Positive source control calls PRESENT only inside a procedure with an accessible optional dummy; source-control mutations use a non-optional local name or inaccessible name with no diagnostic facet.
pending.PRESENT-A-no-other-requirements: Use optional dummies of different declared types, ranks, and attributes and assert only presence truth values; mutation incorrectly restricts the dummy type or rank.

requirements.title: PRESENT result is default logical scalar
requirements.definition: The PRESENT result is a default logical scalar.

pending.PRESENT-result-scalar: Call PRESENT for an optional array dummy and assign to a scalar initialized to the opposite truth value; mutate the dummy rank without changing scalar expectation.

requirements.title: PRESENT result value reports argument presence
requirements.definition: The PRESENT result is true exactly for a present optional dummy argument and false otherwise.

pending.PRESENT-present-argument-true: Invoke a wrapper with the optional argument supplied, initialize the observed logical to false, assign PRESENT(A), and assert true; companion absent call prevents constant true. Add a pass-through wrapper that passes the supplied optional dummy to another procedure optional dummy and assert PRESENT is true there, citing 15.5.2.13 p1 and p4.
pending.PRESENT-absent-argument-false: Invoke the same wrapper with the optional argument omitted, initialize the observed logical to true, assign PRESENT(A), and assert false; companion supplied call prevents default false vacuity. Add a pass-through wrapper that passes the omitted optional dummy to another procedure optional dummy and assert PRESENT is false there, citing 15.5.2.13 p1 and p4.
